sections.title: June 4: New official Youtube channel
items: We've made a new official youtube channel where we will post official updates/announcements and sneak peeks.
We've got a fix for the ghost bug coming soon, and we're working on fixing random server disconnections.

items: If mope.io is blocked for you, try the proxy sites listed on the original page.

sections.title: March 12: Buffs, nerfs, bug fixes, and mud diving!
items: Certain animals (hippo/komodo/pig/warthog/croc/rhino/boa/chicken) can dive in mud now!

sections.title: March 10: We're working on lag fixes
items: In the settings (click the gear button), you can choose lower graphics to make your gameplay smoother (though it may look blurrier)

sections.title: March 3: New Trees, skins, Bigfoot!
items: NEW: Climbable trees (4+ types) + Forest biome! PRESS S TO CLIMB UP/DOWN trees - only certain animals can climb them and 1/4 of the land has loads of them!
Trees turn transparent when a player gets close to them
NEW: a rare Bigfoot animal (dragon tier) throws spears; shop buyable, or 1/1000 rarity
Rivers now shrink (dry up) over time (and re-fill)
A new poison lake (surrounded by hills) appears in the land biome!
NEW: sounds when eating food, drinking water drops, eating animals and dying (a mute button has been added to the settings)
